payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (merged 4a9430a). Blob processor/validator registry: sync validators on PUT /blobs/:id/content over the 4 KiB preview (reject->415 with processorId/reason), async processors via a blob.process job handler registered at boot beside push.deliver; stock mime/size validator + moderation processor; FrickStore::record_derivative. Image-derivative generation (image crate) deferred — the processor seam is the drop-in point.
